title: WebSocket event envelope
description: SPEC-002 MIG-002 capture @98db628. Envelope applied ONLY by wsGateway emit paths (websockets/gateway.ts:73,107,145,178): {event, data, timestamp}. Socket-controller emits bypass it (bare payloads). Preserved verbatim per ADR-026.

event.description: Event name (dot notation), e.g. message.sent, notification.received

data.description: Event payload; conforms to the event-specific schema

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp set at emit time (new Date().toISOString())
